summary: Eps 1-52 adapt Act II chapters 1-169 (its own numbering; vols 1-19) strictly linearly and contiguously at ~3.3 ch/ep: Spring Koshien opening, the new first-years, spring inter-squad/Kanto play, and the summer qualifiers through the Yura match and into the next round. The fandom wiki states an exact chapter range on every episode page, the chain is perfectly contiguous, and ja.wikipedia's episode titles are chapter-title namesakes falling inside the claimed range for 48 of 51 mapped episodes — independent structural corroboration. Ep 29 is a recap (filler, confirmed by animefillerlist); eps 1 and 4 are the only mixed episodes, matching stored types, so no type corrections. The stored ep52 anchor (ch259 v30, 'mu') is wrong for THIS season: it matches Act II Season 2 Part 1's 2026 endpoint (continue at vol 29 ch 260 per wheredoestheanimeleaveoff) and is repaired to ch169 v19 on three sources. MangaShed reports the finale's last scene teases ch189; END kept at 169 per the no-inflation rule.

structure.notes: Single 52-episode season (AniList 105749), our eps 1-52 = broadcast 1-52, no numbering conversion needed. Adaptation is linear and contiguous in Act II's OWN chapter space (ch1-169, vols 1-19); no Act I chapter numbers used anywhere (ep1's Act I recap noted as annotation only). Mid-chapter episode boundaries are common from ep17 onward (page-level splits recorded in chapters_adapted). Volume boundaries: v1:1-9 v2:10-18 v3:19-27 v4:28-37 v5:38-46 v6:47-55 v7:56-64 v8:65-74 v9:75-83 v10:84-93 v11:94-102 v12:103-111 v13:112-120 v14:121-129 v15:130-138 v16:139-147 v17:148-156 v18:157-165 v19:166-174 (fandom Volumes/Act II; Wikipedia agrees). Side story 'Teito vs Ugumori' chapters exist at the end of the volume list — never mainline numbers.
